'''Harko Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located within the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It served as the base of operations for [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane's]] [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|squadron]], as well as a production facility for the new [[Tempest Zero/Legends|Tempest Zero]] advanced fighters. It was destroyed by Republic forces.
